answer: Each agent registers a cryptographic vault whose access pattern is tied to a unique payment stream; the network continuously hashes the timing and amount of those payments into a kin‑link graph. When a new identity appears, it must prove a shared vault or synchronized payment cadence with an existing node, otherwise it is isolated as a potential Sybil. An attacker therefore must duplicate the exact payment schedule and control the underlying vault, raising the cost to the equivalent of a full voyage’s operational budget, an oasis of expense rather than a cheap fable.
